# MH-09 — Repeat a weekly schedule

**Business value:** 945

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As an employee

I want to copy or repeat a schedule across multiple weeks

So that I do not have to configure recurring slots individually


<!-- Manual clarifications below this line are preserved on regeneration. -->

## Clarifications

Is should be possible to replicate the schedule for all the days of a given week into another week instead of having to enter all the slots manually one by one. (they can later be adjusted if required)
